cases.name: fqdn
cases.skip_reason: best-effort: agentcmd does not resolve DNS; equal only when the host has no domain

cases.name: domain_unsupported
cases.skip_reason: hostname -d is not supported by agentcmd; GNU output depends on the host's DNS domain

cases.name: set_name_refused
cases.skip_reason: GNU would change the host name when run as root; agentcmd refuses, covered by CLI tests

cases.name: unknown_option
cases.skip_reason: Debian hostname 3.23 exits 255 on usage errors; agentcmd follows coreutils (exit 1)

cases.name: help_exit
cases.skip_reason: Debian hostname 3.23 exits 255 for --help; agentcmd follows coreutils (exit 0)
